fail_closed: inventory idx sequence not contiguous or required keys missing
cohort event absent from inventory, not a generator-domain fire, or lacking a complete h=20 window
control bar absent from inventory or lacking a complete h=20 window
any event/control session_date outside the DEV window 2024-09-16..2026-10-16
missing forward data at any required bar (exit close or ATR absent/None)

execution-only price input: file hash mismatch; row shape drift (keys other than symbol/idx/ts/open); duplicate bar; symbol or index coverage not exactly equal to the inventory's; a price timestamp not exactly equal to the pinned inventory ts at the same (symbol, idx); a missing, None, non-finite, or non-positive open at any required bar (the outcome-blind P7b inventory carries NO open field by design — entry prices come only from this separate input, Decision B item (a); timestamp/finite checks are corr1, review 6406403886)

disclosure header absent, missing a field, or not recomputing exactly from the cohort artifact (eligible / retained / excluded counts and exclusion rate), or scope/basis statement drift from the pinned Decision B texts (Decision B item (c))

execution input byte-hash binding (corr2, readiness finding — ChatGPT desk reply 2026-10-25 22:48 ET, TS 1792982883.654249): the inventory, execution-price, frozen cohort and frozen draws FILES are verified in the CLI execution path against SHA-256 constants compiled into the script itself (PINNED_INPUT_SHA256) before anything is loaded; any byte drift refuses; caller-supplied expected hashes are never trusted — a supplied --*-sha that disagrees with its pinned constant is itself refused

bt_diagnostic.n: int, retained events with a B-T draw

cost_sensitivity.declared_basis: const string: preregistration v0.3 section 5 (H-BUY) — costs cancel in the paired difference; descriptive line only, never a verdict input
cost_sensitivity.primary_paired_excess_pct: float, the primary-horizon mean paired excess in percent

disclosure._mandatory: REQUIRED header (Decision B condition 2). The analysis refuses to emit output without it, and every count must recompute exactly from the pinned cohort artifact: eligible 311, retained 240, excluded 71, exclusion rate 0.2282958199356913 (22.83%) for the frozen successor cohort carried into this amendment
disclosure.eligible_events: int, events in the frozen cohort artifact
disclosure.excluded_events_unmatched: int, eligible minus retained — the events that could not be matched under the frozen step-(c) rules
disclosure.retained_events_matched: int, events the study actually describes
disclosure.scope_statement: const string: results describe ONLY the matched subpopulation; NOT all Quality Flow BUY signals; no validated trading edge

5|10|20.mean_event_return_atr: float, mean of (close[i+h]-open[i+1])/atr[i]; open from the execution-only price input
5|10|20.mean_paired_excess_atr: float, mean of event return minus drawn B-A control mean (ATR units)
5|10|20.mean_paired_excess_pct: float, mean of event return minus drawn B-A control mean (percent)

object.label: const 'DEV EXPLORATORY' — required on every real-data output

primary_paired_excess.block_bootstrap: circular block bootstrap over calendar time, 20-session blocks: {lower_95, upper_95, resample_mean, resample_var, mean_blocks_per_rep, reps} — INTERVAL SEMANTICS (corr2): lower_95 is the 5th percentile of the resample means, a ONE-SIDED 95% lower bound; upper_95 is the 95th percentile, a ONE-SIDED 95% upper bound; jointly [lower_95, upper_95] is a CENTRAL 90% interval — NOT a two-sided 95% interval
primary_paired_excess.cluster_bootstrap: symbol-cluster bootstrap: {lower_95, upper_95, resample_mean, resample_var, clusters, reps} — same interval semantics as block_bootstrap (corr2): lower_95 / upper_95 are separate ONE-SIDED 95% bounds (5th / 95th percentiles); jointly a CENTRAL 90% interval, NOT a two-sided 95% interval
primary_paired_excess.design_effect: float, cluster resample variance of the mean / iid variance of the mean
primary_paired_excess.interval_lower_95: float, from interval_used (ATR-unit paired excess — the frozen inferential basis). SEMANTICS (corr2): the used bootstrap's 5th resample-mean percentile — a ONE-SIDED 95% lower bound; with interval_upper_95 it forms a CENTRAL 90% interval, NOT a two-sided 95% interval
primary_paired_excess.interval_upper_95: float, from interval_used. SEMANTICS (corr2): the used bootstrap's 95th resample-mean percentile — a ONE-SIDED 95% upper bound; with interval_lower_95 it forms a CENTRAL 90% interval, NOT a two-sided 95% interval
primary_paired_excess.interval_used: 'block' | 'cluster' — the WIDER of the two intervals (frozen rule)
primary_paired_excess.mean_pct: float, reporting view only; inference stays on the ATR-unit excess

object.study_basis: const string: AMENDED under Decision B — DEV-only matched-subpopulation descriptive study; the original EXP-14 protocol remains STOP
object.verdict: const 'DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — no promotional or validated-edge conclusion'
